name: The Shadow
source:
A mysterious being that prowls the streets of Fuyuki City at night, killing countless people. No one knows who or what it is and where it comes from.

[spoiler]After the end of the previous Grail War, her grandfather implanted a piece of the Grail into Sakura in an attempt to recreate it. This led to a remnant of the Third Holy Grail War, the eighth Servant Avenger, attempting to summon himself by controlling Sakura with an alternate persona, The Shadow.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Fate/stay_night_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
